description: This file defines the ILocalClientDirectory interface within the Orleans runtime grain directory component, specifying methods for local lookup of grain addresses.

classes.name: ILocalClientDirectory
classes.description: An internal interface for local client directory operations within Orleans, providing methods for grain address lookup.

methods.name: TryLocalLookup
methods.description: Attempts to find local addresses for a given grain ID, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of grain addresses for a specified grain ID.
